div.div: Validated against the current code (differs from the legacy current/future-state diagrams): no CloudFront edge; a sliding-window admission read replaces the old counter gate; a single-state Step Functions machine (ReserveBudget → Success) with the Bedrock Processor as an async Lambda; the queued path writes QUEUED / 202 and holds the task token (no execution resume at enqueue) until the drained call sends the single callback; the scheduled Reconciliation Lambda was removed (60 s TTL + inline expiry).
